destination.name: Sunshine Coast
destination.tagline: Long surf beaches, rainforest hills and relaxed seaside towns north of Brisbane
destination.description: The Sunshine Coast stretches for nearly 70 km north of Brisbane, from Caloundra through Mooloolaba and Maroochydore to Coolum. Most of its draw is the white-sand beaches, many patrolled by surf life savers, with a salt-water pool at Kings Beach and kitesurfing at Golden Beach. Behind the beaches sit family attractions such as Australia's Big Pineapple, a wildlife zoo and an aquarium. It is a holiday coast for Queenslanders as much as for visitors.
whyVisit: Meet animals at zoos and aquariums

goodToKnow.title: Swim between the flags
goodToKnow.detail: Swim only between the red and yellow flags on patrolled beaches.

goodToKnow.title: A car is the easiest way
goodToKnow.detail: The coast is about 70 km long and the hinterland and attractions are spread out, so a car or tour makes it far simpler to cover.

goodToKnow.title: Popular holiday coast
goodToKnow.detail: It is a popular holiday spot, so book ahead.

destination.bestTimeBlurb: Dry, sunny days from {months} suit the beaches and the Mount Coolum walk. Summer is humid and stormy.
